- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:lines 979-984, the parametrize block of test_adjacent_fd_redirect_does_not_create_numeric_refspec | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The tab-separated FD-redirect regression case is missing.
  WHY: The parser explicitly treats tab as a word delimiter (`_SHELL_WORD_DELIMITERS = frozenset(" \t\r" + ...)` at .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:120 and `lexer.whitespace = " \t\r"` at line 259), so `HEAD:feature/open\t2>/dev/null` is a real input shape the guard must handle. With the digit "2" separated from the refspec by a tab (not a space), the adjacency check at line 277 (`previous_end == token_end - len(token)`) decides whether "2" is popped as an FD or kept as an argument; this exact boundary is untested. A future change to the adjacency heuristic could silently regress tab handling and no test would catch it, since every existing entry uses a space or no separator.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
